dailymail/4012.summary: Thomas Murphy, 59, was driving in Manorville, New York when he lost control of his vehicle and rammed into five boys walking along the shoulder of the road. All the boys - between 12 and 16 years old - were immediately taken to the hospital. Murphy, of Holbrook, was arrested and charged with the DWI following the crash on David Terry Road at 1.30pm on Sunday.

dailymail/4024.summary: Therese Coffey said children play with the toys for only five minutes. She called on the fast food firm and other companies to make ‘symbolic changes’ to show they are reducing single-use plastics. Ministers have taken action to cut plastic waste and the Mail’s Turn the Tide on Plastic campaign has led to curbs.

dailymail/4046.summary: The gruesome white dress is splattered with blood, torn at the bottom and shows the 'not so pretty princess'' ribcage. One royal fan said: 'I hope people boycott this site. This is really scraping the barrel. It's twisted and warped' The Zombie Princess costume does show up in a search of the website when the outfit is clicked on, the site says the next page cannot be found.

dailymail/4052.summary: PM warned there is a 'lot of work to do' to convince party members of Chequers. Comes as she struggles to keep her plan alive despite heavy fire from MPs. Chancellor Philip Hammond has openly lambasted rival ideas as a 'fantasy' Former foreign secretary Johnson due to launch another salvo against the PM.

dailymail/4062.summary: Liam Duggan and Jamie Cripps got inked in the kitchen of Nic Naitanui's home. The pair were celebrating the Eagles' AFL grand final win with a tattoo in Nait anui's kitchen. The Perth pair were inked on their legs in Youngbloods Tattoo Studio. The Eagles won the AFL grandfinal against Collingwood on Sunday night.

dailymail/4063.summary: Hundreds of survivors formed a human chain circling the shuttered site of last year's horrific violence. A ceremony was held to dedicate a quarter-acre memorial garden, which features a tree for each of the victims along with an oak that represents life. Nevada Gov Brian Sandoval and Arizona Rep Gabby Giffords were among the more than 200 people in attendance.

dailymail/4076.summary: The Irukandji jellyfish is a hyper-venomous species of box jellyfish. It is typically found in the waters in Queensland's far north. But after a jellyfish was captured off the coast of Fraser Island earlier this year experts have fears the deadly jellyfish are migrating south.

dailymail/4081.summary: Student was refusing to leave Middlesbrough College this afternoon. Tussle with police officer saw him tackle officer and grab on to his clothes. But moments later the sound of a taser sends shudders through crowd. Cleveland Police said that the student was 'posing an on-going threat to staff and students' and 'injured the officer'

dailymail/4088.summary: Fabio Trabocchi, who is also head chef at Fiola, said he has shut down social media. Said he has been bombarded with death threats and threats to destroy the restaurant. Dismissed a 'crazy' rumor that he tipped off protesters about Cruz's location. Said staff at all his restaurants will be given extra training in how to handle situations.

dailymail/4113.summary: A 48-year-old man was allegedly standing outside a Fremantle pub with two mates about 11. 20pm on Saturday when he was knocked to the ground unconscious. Police allege the three friends were on the sidewalk when a stranger pushed one of the men and struck another and a fight broke out. The father-of-three was allegedly struck and knocked unconscious as he tried to intervene and separate the men. A 43-year, and 36-year old man were also knocked unconscious before the alleged attacker ran off along South Terrace in a south easterly direction. All three men were later taken to hospital by emergency services. The 48- year-old was treated for serious head injuries

dailymail/4120.summary: Pop-up store was selling limited edition items from a collaboration with Off-White. Shouting can be heard in the short clip as people make a run for the entrance. IKEA France has apologised for the inconvenience caused. The collaboration was announced back in June 2017.

dailymail/4131.summary: The high-profile airing of sexual assault allegations against Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh has led victims around the country to flood support center lines with calls. For many who had stifled painful memories for years, hearing Christine Blasey Ford share her accusation against Kavanaugh reopened old wounds. For others dealing with a recent experience of assault, it has spurred them to report the crimes or seek counseling or other help.

dailymail/4134.summary: Road sweeper was sweeping ground in a university in Wuhan when the incident happened. The worker jumped onto the car bonnet when the driver, Ms Li, was about to leave. The two had an argument over the incident and the driver drove away with the worker on top of her car.

dailymail/4146.summary: Trump made the crack while defending his Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh, who is being charged with sexual assault stemming back from his high school days. 'If we find one on him,' Trump said, waving his hands in disbelief, 'then that's going to be the greatest shock of all time' The crowd laughed as Pence sat in the front row of the presser, shaking his head and chuckling.

dailymail/4148.summary: Adam Nolin, 33, is suspected of shooting dead his girlfriend Tia Mae Randall, 27, Thursday in Wyoming, Michigan. He was arraigned Friday in a hospital where he is being treated after an officer ran him down with a police SUV as Nolin shot at them while trying to flee on a busy highway. Nolin has been charged with five felony counts including assault with intent to murder and fleeing police.

dailymail/4170.summary: Therese Roever, 37, was charged in February with attempted capital murder. She allegedly poisoned her nine-year-old girl, her twin brother, and seven-year old son, at their home in Olathe, during a custody battle. Now it appears she attempted to have her ex-husband John murdered. Court documents say she told another inmate she would rather die in prison or have the children go to foster care, than have her husband get custody.

dailymail/4172.summary: Tara Fares, 22, was shot dead in her car in Baghdad on Thursday. She had built an Instagram following of 2.7 million people. Fares was the target of a deluge of online insults over her perceived lack of modesty. She was the fourth female entrepreneur to die in recent weeks.

dailymail/4231.summary: The 72-year-old singer will attend the ceremony at the Kennedy Center in Washington DC December 2. She will attend in the middle of her world tour which began September 21 and runs through May, ending in Minneapolis. The White House said no decisions had been made on whether Trump would participate in this year's Kennedy Center Honors program.

dailymail/4233.summary: Clive Schlee, 59, is in line for a windfall reported to be more than £30million. The sale means a cash bonanza for everyone at Pret – not just the chief executive. Next month all 12,000 employees will receive a bonus of £1,000.

dailymail/4235.summary: Mike Glover-Johnson, 46, was attacked on the street in Bloxwich, Walsall. He claims Chunky Grill restaurant in Bl Oxwich 'threw him out' on the road. He also claims they tried to charge him for water used to save his face. Owner of the takeaway denies the allegations and says he did all he could.

dailymail/4253.summary: Charles 'Chad' Ludington, a former Yale University classmate of Brett Kavanaugh's, said he is 'deeply troubled' by what he claims is a blatant mischaracterization by Kavanaugh of his drinking. Ludington said he heard Brett slur his words and saw him staggering from alcohol consumption. He said that when drunk, Kavanaugh was often 'belligerent and aggressive' and once started a fight that ended with one of their mutual friends in jail.

dailymail/4260.summary: Black smoke could be seen billowing from a flat in Cottingley Towers. The 1970s-built block is owned by Leeds City Council and contains socially-rented flats. Four people were treated for smoke inhalation at the scene. Police cordon has been placed around the block as emergency workers investigate whether or not the building is safe for residents to enter.

dailymail/4262.summary: Sir Stephenson said he would be open to the charge of treason being levelled against those convicted of terrorist activities. He said many Australian businesses were unprepared for terrorist attacks. Sir Stephenson is working with former New South Wales deputy police commissioner Nick Kaldas to improve intelligence sharing between public and private law enforcement.

dailymail/4268.summary: Jordan Loewe claims that she arrived at Track's home on Friday night to drop off their son, and that as she began to leave her ex suddenly demanded she give him a hug. LoewE, whose protective order against Track was just lifted in late August, was then told by Track that she could not leave, at which point she pulled out her phone and stated: 'If you don't let me leave I'm going to call the police' That is when Track allegedly took her phone, even as she tried to remove their son from her ex's home. She eventually yelled loud enough to get her phone back and called authorities, who also claim that they were attacked by the 29

dailymail/4269.summary: West Coast have won the 2018 AFL Grand Final by five points. The match was a contest for the ages, with a thrilling final term. The Eagles took the lead with two minutes to go but Jack Darling fumbled the ball on the goal line. Luke Shuey was awarded the Norm Smith medal as the best player on ground.

dailymail/4270.summary: 'So if African-American unemployment is now at the lowest number in history, median income the highest, and you then add all of the other things I have done, how do Democrats, who have done NOTHING for African-Americans but TALK, win the Black Vote? And it will only get better!' he tweeted on Sunday afternoon. Black unemployment hit a record low of 5. 9 percent in May. It has risen a little since - it was 6. 3 percent in August - but is still at historic lows. Trump won 8 percent of the black vote in the 2016 election but Hillary Clinton took 89 percent of their vote.

dailymail/4274.summary: Man approached by reporter as he left a Tesco in Belfast. He denies planting the bombs or knowing that the bombings were going to take place. He responded to further questions with: 'I've got nothing to say' The confrontation is an excerpt from a new documentary by the journalist. ITV's The Hunt For The Birmingham Bombers will be broadcast at 10.30pm tonight.

dailymail/4319.summary: Duchess of Sussex had skipped today's royal engagements to take a well-earned break. She was spotted holding hands with Prince Harry on a jetty on picturesque Fraser Island. The couple had spent the morning at their hotel recuperating from the heavy schedule. A royal aide said she took a break from engagements because of a 'tiring few days'

dailymail/4343.summary: The community garden will be dedicated to the victims as well as those who survived the massacre. The garden, located at 1015 S. Casino Center Blvd, has been updated over the past year to include a large pair of angel wings etched with the initials of the those who were killed.

dailymail/4375.summary: Donatella Versace has been sold to U.S. clothing giant Michael Kors. The 63-year-old has been artistic director and vice-president of the company. She has been attached to the Italian fashion house since her brother Gianni was shot dead in 1997.

dailymail/4381.summary: The 24-year-old customer caught the video at around 8pm Wednesday night. He said the 'toilets were dripping through the ceiling onto the floor by the plate warmers and all over the ice machine' The customer also described the 'overbearing' smell of 'urine and faeces' in the restaurant. Nando's said the leak was most likely caused by the kitchen which is directly above the affected area.

dailymail/4386.summary: Group of eight were spotted partying at the top of the Seven Sisters cliffs. They stood on the edge of the cliff, which is separated from the face by a crack. Two men then walked to the edge and urinated off the first of the famous cliffs. Photographer Wayne Spring said he was amazed by the men's stupidity.

dailymail/4401.summary: Julie Swetnick, 55, is the third woman to accuse Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh of sexual misconduct. In 2000, the Portland-based company Webtrends filed a civil lawsuit against Swetnik alleging that she 'engaged in unwelcome, sexually offensive conduct' during a business lunch with two male employees and WebtTrends customers. Swetick was also accused of making 'false and retaliatory allegations that other co-workers had engaged in inappropriate conduct towards her' The lawsuit was dismissed shortly after it was filed in 2000, something Swetenick's attorney Michael Avenatti says proves the company's allegations are 'completely bogus'

dailymail/4407.summary: Mandy Allwood, 53, became world famous when she announced she was expecting octuplets in 1996. But the six boys and two girls, who were born over three days and three nights, did not survive. She said Diana would meet her at fancy hotels such as the Ritz and the Dorchester in London where they would chat about their struggles with depression.

dailymail/4413.summary: The unnamed man reported an incident where his 'close acquaintance' said she 'was sexually assaulted by two heavily inebriated men she referred to at the time as Brett and Mark' on a boat in Newport in the summer of 1985. The person reported the incident to the Senate Committee on the Judiciary on Monday. The man got in touch about the rape incident that took place on a. boat in 1985 when he saw a picture of Kavanaugh in his high school yearbook last weekend. The complaint was made to Senator Sheldon Whitehouse's office Monday and the Committee spoke with Kavanaugh as soon as the following day for questioning.

dailymail/4423.summary: Ollie Roberts, 21, was the Queen's first openly gay footman. He was required to accompany Her Majesty on all her carriage rides. He also carried out other duties like collecting her mail at Buckingham Palace. But he has now stood down after being demoted for 'courting publicity'

dailymail/4431.summary: Police chief and state's attorney say they will investigate any claim 'to the fullest extent' But they say it would be impossible to prosecute if a complaint was filed. If a complaint of rape is made, there is no statute of limitations. Kavanaugh is accused of pulling psychologist Dr Christine Blasey Ford into a bedroom during a high school party in 1982, pinning her onto a bed, and covering her mouth as he tried to take her clothes off.

dailymail/4438.summary: The 39-year-old rapper addressed the controversy during an interview with DailyMailTV at the amfAR Gala red carpet on Thursday. Osbourne argued that the Duchess of Sussex 'ain't black' and is of 'mixed race' instead. Eve fired back saying: 'She's black, she's half black. ' She admitted that while she desperately misses Chen, she has 'no idea' if there are plans for her to return to her seat at the table.

dailymail/4466.summary: President tweeted at 8. 30pm: 'Just started, tonight, our 7th FBI investigation of Judge Brett Kavanaugh' White House announced the 'supplemental investigation' at 5pm on Friday. Republicans said it would take 'up to' a week, while Democrats said it could take a week. The White House said it must be 'limited in scope' and 'current credible allegations' Republicans insisted on the phrase 'currentredible allegations' to keep at bay new accusations.

dailymail/4472.summary: Warford Hall is a huge manor house built in 1897 in one of the most affluent neighbourhoods in the UK. The 11-bedroom mansion currently belongs to Real Housewives of Cheshire star Dawn Ward and her footballer turned property developer husband Ashley Ward. The property has plenty of rooms to fill, and has also recently added a new salon area, staff quarters and a leisure suite.

dailymail/4496.summary: Colbert compared the judge's nomination to a video of a seal hitting a kayaker on the head with an octopus. He said it was the 'perfect metaphor' for what had happened. 'The seal represents the patriarchy, and it's using the octopus - aka, Brett Kavanaugh's Supreme Court seat - to attack the kayaker - or the women of America'

At the end of the video, the boy recording the video approaches Michael and mockingly asks him: ‘you have a comment on the 2018 phone breaking?’ When Michael brushes him off, theBoy retorts: � 'I'm sorry for your loss. ’

dailymail/4505.summary: A 19-year-old driver was allegedly driving on the wrong side of the road when he collided with 27-year old driver. The Hyundai's driver was knocked unconscious by the collision. A home doctor was the first on the scene who helped Mr Weaver to safety. The teenager remains in a stable condition at Royal Adelaide Hospital.

dailymail/4510.summary: Collingwood coach Nathan Buckley stopped to console a distraught supporter. The banner was torn apart by the wind seconds before the team were due to run through it. Buckley stopped the game to console the woman. The players took a moment to stand in front of the remains of the banner.

dailymail/4518.summary: West Coast players celebrated their premiership win with a beer stunt. Forward Scott Lycett was filmed drinking from the trophy as teammates celebrated around him. The Eagles then donned white shirt with their jerseys worn over the top and made their way to official celebrations. Earlier the players celebrated on the field in the minutes after winning, with their families including numerous young children joining them. The mood was completely different in the Collingwood camp as the heartbreaking loss in the final minute of the game left players in tears on the pitch.

dailymail/4519.summary: Jo Whiley shared a picture of her and male colleagues on Instagram this morning. She appeared to be having a jibe about the lack of women presenters on BBC radio. She was pictured with Mayo and an otherwise male dominant line-up of colleagues. Jo became a co-host of Mayo's previous one-man afternoon show in May. She will now host the Drivetime slot, which was extended to 8pm in the evening. Mayo previously claimed he was unhappy at sharing the show with his co- host. He was paid up to £350,000 in 2017/18, although that wage includes his work for Radio Five Live.

dailymail/4541.summary: Paul Davis, retail fraud director at Lloyds Banking Group, said scam texts are so sophisticated. He said criminals can mimic the exact format of messages using technique called 'spoofing' Mr Davis said customers should be taught how to respond to them to avoid being lured into a scam.

dailymail/4545.summary: The Mail has created a quiz to help you find out the secrets of your personality. The multiple-choice questions tell you which of 16 types of person you are. By the end of the questions, you will have chosen one of 16 personality types (see box)

dailymail/4570.summary: Megyn Kelly Today launched last September after securing a three-year contract for a staggering $69 million. Despite NBC heavily promoting the 47-year-old's show, her ratings have been abysmal. Megyn began extensively covering the #MeToo movement in a bid to carve out a place for her show, even covering her own colleagues at the network who had been accused or fired over allegations of sexual misconduct. NBC president Andy Lack is said to be 'annoyed' by Megyn's attempts to turn her show into a forum for the movement.

dailymail/4589.summary: The score is level at 55 points with just a quarter to go in the AFL Grand Final. It is the first time the score has been tied at three-quarter time in a Grand Final since 1937. West Coast last made the Grand Final in 2015 where they were beaten by Hawthorn. The match was delayed by just seconds as the team's banner was torn apart by the wind.

dailymail/4595.summary: The model-turned-actress shared a series of videos early Friday showing three open car doors on her two SUVs and large dirty paw prints inside the vehicle. 'Bears broke into our f-ing cars last night! Or a bear,' she explained as she panned the video around her driveway.

dailymail/4599.summary: Tanushree Dutta claimed Nana Patekar harassed her on sets of a film in 2008. She had made the same allegations shortly after the incident and Patekar denied the allegations. Priyanka Chopra tweeted: 'Agreed. the world needs to #BelieveSurviviors'

dailymail/4621.summary: Laila Rouass says she was raped by someone she knew. She later 'found the courage' to report the assault to the police. But she was advised that a conviction was 'unlikely' The actress said she 'shed so many tears' after the rape.

dailymail/4637.summary: Former High Court judge Kenneth Hayne has savaged the conduct of Australia's financial institutions. He said the banks and other financial institutions had 'put profits before people' The report also criticised the corporate regulator ASIC and the Australian Prudential Regulation Authority. Treasurer Josh Frydenberg said the report was a 'frank and scathing assessment' of Australia’s financial services culture.

dailymail/4671.summary: Professor Steve Joordens of the University of Toronto's Scarborough Campus started his 9am course entitled Introduction to Biological and Cognitive Psychology. He connected his computer to the projector, without realizing he had pornography playing on his laptop. Then the graphic video played on the big screen in front of the classroom for all the students to see and hear.

dailymail/4674.summary: The chocolate poodle has an eerily human-like face in the video. The dog is seen wearing striped socks on its paws. The toy poodle looks incredibly shaken after being told off by owner. The ten-second-long video has left people scratching their heads.

dailymail/4677.summary: Rachel Mitchell was the GOP's star surrogate during the hearing. She was criticized for her dry questions and seemingly pointless digressions. She never directly challenged Christine Ford's recollection of being groped and pinned to a bed at a high school party in 1982. 'She was not exactly a rock star,' one Republican Senate aide told DailyMail.com.

dailymail/4678.summary: The relatively warm September means there has been no demand for knitwear and coats. This has put pressure on chains to offer price cuts on autumn season stock. M&S, Next, New Look, Asos, Debenhams and H&M were among those offering discounts.

dailymail/4679.summary: Rachel Mitchell said she believed there was not enough to criminally charge Kavanaugh. She said there was likely not even enough to seek a search warrant. Mitchell's legal opinion may have helped sway key Judiciary Committee Republican Jeff Flake, who had been on the fence. Despite her reported help in assuaging Republican senators who may be on the sidelines, Mitchell's performance in the hearing was panned by pundits on both sides of the aisle.
